Hi all — I reviewed Jordan's annotated MSA and pulled suggested responses inline. Summary recommendations:

1) Indemnity: propose a narrow carveout that clarifies IP claims related to customer-provided data are the customer's responsibility, but Redwood will indemnify for claims arising from Redwood-modified core model outputs where we used third-party components. Suggested one-paragraph change attached as redline.

2) Data retention & export: we cannot commit to 7 years for all logs by default; offer a scoped retention schedule: 3 years standard + an optional contractual extension to 7 years for regulated customers at a modest surcharge. Include export-on-termination within 90 days and support for secure transfer (SFTP).

3) Liability cap: we are willing to increase to 1.5x fees for proven gross negligence with carveouts for fraud and will not accept open-ended 2x for all negligence; provide insurance certificate instead.

4) Compliance evidence: agree to provide SOC 2 reports on a quarterly attestation cadence and provide an on-demand compliance pack under NDA.

Commercial compromise: sales can offer a 12-month firm term at the discounted rate today plus an optional auto-extension for the second year at a pre-agreed uplift (5%). If Avery requires a firm 24-month commitment for pricing, recommend a 5% one-time credit (onboarding credit) instead of lowering the rate.

Next steps:
- I attached an annotated response (MSA_redlines_response.docx) with suggested language.
- If Sales prefers the supplement approach, we can draft a single-page MSA supplement + DPA that captures the retention carveout and capacity schedule. That would be fastest to sign.
- Tessa/Logan: confirm which commercial path you want (12+opt-in vs firm 24). If 24, I'll prepare a tracked redline that reflects the increased commercial exposure.
